now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 3, James gives the device to Daisy and Lincoln.

proposed.text: In season 3, James agrees to trade the device to Daisy and Lincoln for a Terrigen Crystal, but Lincoln takes it without paying.

changes.evidence: In 'Paradise Lost' (AoS S3), James agrees to swap the Kree Orb for a Terrigen Crystal, but Lincoln tricks him and snatches the Orb without handing over the crystal; James does not give it to them.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
proposed.text: Hank's ants find him and repair the ship, and he flies it to Axia for the final battle.

changes.evidence: After M.O.D.O.K. destroys Krylar's yacht, Hank Pym's ants locate him and repair it, and Hank pilots it to Axia. The file ends on Destroyed with no record of the repair.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 5, a monolith sends the team to 2091 and back. Later, a bomb shatters three monoliths, and Fitz seals the rift they leave behind.

proposed.text: In season 5, a monolith sends the team to 2091 and back. Later, a bomb shatters three monoliths, and Coulson seals the rift they leave behind with a device Fitz builds.

changes.evidence: In 'The Real Deal' (AoS S5), Coulson carries Fitz's Gravity Containment Device into the Lighthouse basement and places it in the rift; Fitz designs the device but does not seal the rift himself (Daisy later completes the seal with a second device).
